title: Microsoft Teams: external bot detection and activity reports in the Teams admin center
summary: Hold: the summary promises that existing bot policy is unchanged, although Microsoft has not documented the report's arrival behaviour. The briefing also overlooks another published security report and understates documented report access and organizer controls. The roadmap details and the existing bot policy's admin path and approval command are supported.
